source: Production CSV numeric, date and formula XLSX exports and round trips; corrected CSV output fields independently verified with LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. Two unchanged formula-to-text precision differences remain in precision A7:A8. Numeric cell classification, normalized numeric serialization and affected formula values in numbers, quoted, limits, crlf, ranges and reference-types were independently checked against LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. Long numeric fields and blank-cell omissions/counting in limits, empty-fields and reference-types were checked against LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. Exponent associativity, unknown-function argument errors and independent syntax caches were verified against LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 (five cells in precedence, error-order and syntax). Eight formula texts in precedence, types and precision were independently corrected from native XLSX exports for numeric literal formatting. CSV filename worksheet names and Calc intersection references (references A1:A4 and A7) were corrected against fresh native LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 XLSX exports. Logical cache types, Boolean literal normalization and their displayed round trips in formulas, precedence, types, functions, branches and error-order were independently verified against LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. Unknown-function spellings in branches A9 and error-order A1 were independently corrected against fresh LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 exports; their cache types and values are unchanged. Four comparison formula caches and their Boolean display in formulas, precedence and error-order follow independently captured current production (soffice-floor-ceiling and Boolean comparison work). Other native-reference differences are retained. The precision A1 SUM cache and its first displayed row follow fresh current-production cancellation results, captured during the SUM/AVERAGE parity work.
